headline: Executive order sets ethics commitments that certain executive branch employees must follow.
what_it_does: This order sets out ethics commitments for people who work in the federal executive branch. Based on the title, it lays out rules or pledges about how these employees must conduct themselves on ethics matters. No summary was provided, so the specific rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Executive branch employees covered by the order
who_it_affects.how: They are expected to follow the ethics commitments the order sets.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2021; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
